assessment.nobel_worthiness: HPV virus-like-particle vaccines provide an exceptionally clear preventive intervention against infection and several cancers, with major worldwide public-health impact.
assessment.attribution: The proposed three laureates represent the central conceptual and experimental development of the VLP vaccine approach.
assessment.maturity: The biological principle, clinical efficacy, and population-level implementation are all long established.
uncertainties: The contribution must be distinguished carefully from the earlier discovery of HPV carcinogenesis.
Translation and manufacturing involved substantial additional contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology has enabled a highly consequential therapeutic class for diabetes and obesity, with broad clinical and physiological significance.
assessment.attribution: Holst and Mojsov are central to establishing GLP-1 biology, while Knudsen represents pivotal translation into durable therapeutic agents.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic effect, safety characterization, and extensive clinical use make the achievement mature.
uncertainties: Credit for the peptide's identification, physiological definition, and drug development is distributed among more than three contributors.
Long-term population effects of widespread treatment continue to be assessed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing transformed the treatment outlook for spinal muscular atrophy and established a powerful RNA-therapeutic principle.
assessment.attribution: Krainer's mechanistic splicing work and Bennett's antisense-therapeutics contribution form a coherent, limited attribution.
assessment.maturity: Clinical benefit is well documented and the approach has been implemented over sufficient time to establish durable importance.
uncertainties: The translation depended on important contributions in disease genetics, chemistry, clinical development, and delivery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA enabled a fundamental change in prenatal screening by obtaining clinically informative fetal genetic signals noninvasively.
assessment.attribution: The discovery is unusually well centered on Lo's identification and development of fetal DNA analysis in maternal plasma.
assessment.maturity: The method has broad clinical adoption and its diagnostic performance has been extensively evaluated.
uncertainties: Screening rather than definitive diagnosis creates important limits on clinical interpretation.
The downstream ethical and implementation consequences vary across health systems.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: PCSK9 human genetics provided compelling target validation for a major new strategy to lower LDL cholesterol and prevent cardiovascular disease.
assessment.attribution: Hobbs and Cohen were central to the human-genetic evidence, and Seidah to the molecular identification of PCSK9.
assessment.maturity: The genetic mechanism and therapeutic value of PCSK9 inhibition have been strongly confirmed in clinical use.
uncertainties: The evidence supplied identifies several additional contributors whose relative claims require careful comparison.
Recognition must distinguish discovery of the target from later drug development.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics introduced a transformative way to test causal functions of genetically specified cells and has reshaped experimental neuroscience and physiology.
assessment.attribution: Bamberg and Nagel are central to channelrhodopsin characterization, while Deisseroth was pivotal in establishing the method as a broadly usable biological tool.
assessment.maturity: The approach is deeply established across laboratories and has produced extensive mechanistic insight.
uncertainties: The foundational work spans microbial photoreceptors, engineering, and in vivo application, creating difficult three-person attribution choices.
Clinical application remains more limited than experimental impact.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adult stem-cell-derived organoids made it possible to model normal tissue, disease, and treatment response in experimentally tractable human-relevant systems.
assessment.attribution: Clevers and Sato provide a compact and coherent attribution for the key intestinal adult-stem-cell organoid advance.
assessment.maturity: The platform has been replicated, diversified across tissues, and integrated into basic and translational research.
uncertainties: Organoid development includes major antecedents and parallel advances in stem-cell culture.
The degree to which organoids reproduce whole-organ physiology varies by model.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: High-frequency deep brain stimulation produced a major, durable advance in treating motor manifestations of Parkinson's disease and changed functional neurosurgery.
assessment.attribution: Benabid is strongly and directly associated with the defining therapeutic innovation.
assessment.maturity: Its benefit, limitations, and clinical place have been established through decades of use.
uncertainties: The mechanism of therapeutic stimulation remains incompletely resolved.
Important contributions to target selection, surgical technique, device development, and clinical validation extend beyond a single investigator.
